title: The 3 Lists That Turned Claude Into My Employee
description:
An AI assistant starts every session with no memory of the last one, so most people never get real work out of it. The fix is three lists kept in a plain notes folder: what only you can do, what the AI does alone, and what needs both. It reads them at the start of every session.

This short covers the three-list system, how to point Claude Code at a notes folder, and the Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern where the AI maintains your knowledge base instead of searching it.

Get the full template and guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rA9DXAXrjMj3CSjQn-KOVdvoBvmOEWpchwpC0w56X5w/edit?usp=sharing
